authoredPrompt: This figure is part of a worked example asking to evaluate the line integral of (xy + z^3) ds from (1, 0, 0) to (-1, 0, pi) along a helix. The figure shows a 3D rectangular bounding box with x ranging from -1 to 1, y from -1 to 1, and z from 0 to pi. A single helical curve C spirals inside the box from the labeled starting point (1, 0, 0) at the bottom to the endpoint (-1, 0, pi) at the top, with a directional arrow indicating the orientation of traversal. The figure shows the geometry of the helix C in xyz-space, establishing the path and its orientation for setting up the arc-length line integral using the parametric equations x = cos t, y = sin t, z = t for t in [0, pi].
authoredInteractions:
- Slider for parameter t (0 to π): animate a point tracing along the 3D curve from (1, 0, 0) to (-1, 0, π), displaying the current coordinates and arc-length increment in real time
- Drag to rotate the 3D bounding box to view the helical curve from any angle and reveal its shape in each projected plane

discrepancies: Initial camera/view is substantially rotated from the source: the helix starts at the lower right and ends upper left, whereas the source starts lower left and ends near the top center, changing the recognizable composition.
The starting point is shown as an orange moving tracer in the default view, but the source has both endpoints as blue dots with no orange point.
Axis labels and tick labels are placed on different faces/edges than in the source, with the z label on the right instead of the left and several 0/1 labels not matching the source positions.
An extra curve label 'C' is added on the helix, which is not present in the source figure.
The blue arrowhead is larger and located more centrally on the curve than in the source, where it is smaller and placed on the lower-right ascending segment.
evaluation.notes: The helix inside the bounding box is conceptually correct and usefully interactive, but the default view, endpoint color, and label placement differ noticeably from the source.
action_items: Set the initial orthographic camera to match the source orientation, with the start point at the lower left and endpoint near the upper center.
Make the default start endpoint blue like the source, or hide/recolor the orange tracer until interaction begins.
Move the x, y, z and tick labels onto the same visible edges/faces as the source figure.
Remove the extra 'C' label or make it optional if the goal is to reproduce the textbook figure exactly.
